note: Skills V loads from outside its workspace (~/.agents/skills, ~/.openclaw/skills). They are third-party packs, not V's own text, so the workspace does not copy them; the installer (line A) installs the 'install' ones at pinned versions. Snapshot of V on 2026-11-27.

install.skills: lark-* (approval, base, calendar, contact, doc, drive, event, im, mail, markdown, meeting, minutes, okr, openapi-explorer, shared, sheets, skill-maker, slides, task, vc, whiteboard, wiki, workflow-*)
install.source: the skill pack shipped with @larksuite/cli (same version as tools.json)
install.why: 写飞书（文档、日程、任务、多维表、表格、知识库）和 V 一样；TOOLS.md 与 feishu-* skill 都调用它们

install.skills: feishu-bitable, feishu-calendar, feishu-channel-rules, feishu-im-read, feishu-task, feishu-troubleshoot
install.source: bundled with the @openclaw/feishu channel plugin (comes with the runtime)
install.why: 飞书渠道自带，无需另装；列出来只为核对
创作能力；没有 MAKARON_API_KEY 时 skill 会如实说没开通

install.source: scene-cli npm package (`scene skill install --target <skills root>`)
install.why: Scene 素材检索的官方 CLI skill；主人在 Scene 建个人 key（`scene auth set-key`）就能用，没有 key 时如实说没开通。V 的飞书搜索站部分不带

install.source: public third-party skills, pinned versions under their own licences
install.why: 演示 / 网页类，和 V 一致（2026-11-27 定：能用就带）
视频动效创作，和 V 一致；需要 Chrome 和 ffmpeg，机器上没有时 skill 会报缺依赖
